risk_summary:
• Water dripping from AC unit at location E6
• Potential slip hazard for 12 impacted occupants
• Risk of minor water damage to surrounding area/property
contextual_insights: AC leaks are commonly caused by clogged condensate drain lines, improper installation, or frozen coils. While the operational impact is minor, stagnant water can create slip hazards and risk property or ceiling damage if left unaddressed. Facilities should clear the drain line and ensure electrical components beneath or near the leak are safely isolated.
escalation_reason: Hazard does not meet the criteria for urgent escalation.
